goal: Verify that a user can create a new account as the Site Host and successfully navigate the calendar to view the month of July 2026.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar for June 2026, click the 'Next month' button (indicated by a right arrow icon) to advance the calendar view.
Click on the 'July 2026' button or header within the calendar interface to open the full year view and confirm the selection of July.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the sign-up page to the main application dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view updates from 'June 2026' to 'July 2026' after clicking the navigation button.
The full year calendar view for 2026 is displayed, with the 'JUL' (July) section clearly visible.
The main feed below the calendar displays existing entries (e.g., 'Personal reminder for the weekend') without any error messages.
